name: ManiSkill / SAPIEN
summary: Built on the SAPIEN engine, ManiSkill provides GPU-parallelized simulation and rendering for manipulation, with particular emphasis on articulated objects — drawers, cabinets, faucets — and generalizable object-level skills. Its successive versions have run public challenges that shaped how the community measures generalization to unseen object instances.
innovation: GPU-parallel rendering as well as physics, allowing vision-based RL at high throughput.
A focus on articulated and category-level object generalization rather than fixed rigid objects.
matters: The main fully open alternative to NVIDIA's stack for large-scale manipulation training, and the base SIMPLER builds on.
limits: A smaller asset ecosystem than commercial simulators, and less established sim-to-real evidence.
lineage: Open academic GPU simulation for manipulation, developed in parallel with the Isaac line.
